From a box of paper to one tidy file

The paperwork doesn't change — the awarding body's forms stay exactly as they are. What changes is how long it takes, and how much goes missing.

Paper

  • Registers copied up after the course
  • Assessment checklists ticked on a clipboard
  • Exam papers posted, scanned or lost
  • Feedback forms collected, then counted by hand
  • Evenings spent building the file for the IQA

Digital Training Centre

  • Photograph the register — names are read in automatically
  • Tick competencies on the iPad as the course runs
  • Photograph exam papers — filed against each learner
  • Learners scan a QR code and give feedback on their phone
  • One tap for the full course pack, ready for review

Everything a course needs, from the register to the IQA sign-off.

Admin, assessment and IQA

Every learner, every criterion, every course — in one grid that fills in as the course runs. When it's done, the trainer submits the pack and it lands with your IQA, ready to review.

  • Tap-to-tick competency grids built on the awarding body's criteria
  • One tap to submit a complete, signed course pack
  • IQA review with outcome, date and actions for the trainer
  • Admin portal to search every course, learner and trainer

Knowledge Centre & QR quizzes

Put a QR code on the screen and the whole room joins from their phones. Short, lively questions through the day, with the class's answers revealed live — so you can see what's landed and what needs another pass before the assessment.

Question 3 of 8200 pts

What rate should chest compressions be delivered at?

Correct! +100

Instructor CPD centre

Every trainer gets their own login and their own CPD record — built from the courses they actually deliver, so the portfolio your awarding body asks for is already written.

  • Individual logins for every instructor, with their own courses and records
  • Hours logged automatically from each course and each day taught
  • Knowledge centre for instructors — study sessions, guideline updates and quizzes that count towards CPD
  • Portfolio download ready for external quality assurance

How it works

From choosing a plan to your first submitted course pack — set up once, then the same routine for every course.

Pick a plan

Choose Solo for an independent trainer or Centre for a team of up to 10 — or talk to us about a bespoke licence for larger providers.

See pricing

Design

We set up your courses, awarding-body forms and scenarios, ready for your first course. With a bespoke licence, a dedicated developer also builds in your own paperwork and branding, and walks your team through it.

Add trainers, deliver and assess

Give each trainer their own login. They photograph the register, run scenarios and skills stations, and tick competencies as learners achieve them.

Submit the pack

Capture exam papers and QR feedback, sign, and submit the complete course pack for IQA review — often before the kit is packed away.

Your paperwork, made digital

Every organisation has its own forms — in-house assessments, induction checklists, risk assessments, sign-off sheets. Send us what you use today and we'll build it into your own version of the Digital Training Centre, with your branding, your courses and your process.

Talk to us about your courses
"We still do all of this on paper…"

That's usually where we start. Bring the form, the checklist or the spreadsheet — we'll show you how it looks on an iPad.
